data.exact_reserve_text: Losses from large events such as Hurricane Ian and the Ukraine conflict have been within planned assumptions, while good loss experience has generated a healthy release from prior year reserves. Profit releases on open years of GBP 15.7m (2021: GBP 2.4m) were made during the year.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2022 were GBP 97.541m. During 2022 there was a net favourable movement on prior years with a gross release of GBP 38.978m, driven by favourable claims development and generally benign claims experience; management notes this as a "healthy release from prior year reserves" and records profit releases on open years of GBP 15.7m. Large loss events such as Hurricane Ian and the Ukraine conflict were within planned assumptions and did not prevent the overall prior-year release.
raw_causal_phrases: good loss experience has generated a healthy release from prior year reserves.
Profit releases on open years of GBP 15.7m (2021: GBP 2.4m) were made during the year.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (gross claims liabilities) at 1 Jan 2022. Prior year development taken from the 'Movement arising from prior years' gross column in the Insurance liabilities movement table (note 12). Narrative references to 'profit releases' are net amounts; the gross PY movement from the table (-GBP 38.978m) is used as the authoritative figure. No gross per-line-of-business prior-year reserve movements are disclosed, so lob_movements are omitted. No gross claims development triangle was provided in the disclosed pages (triangle = none).
